restaurantName: The Old Government House Hotel and Spa
address: St Ann's Place, St Peter Port, Guernsey,GY1 2NU
bio: The Old Government House Hotel and Spa is Guernsey's first and only 5 star hotel. The hotel overlooks St Peter Port's harbour and the hotel's stunning gardens.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Sir John Coward Lounge and, weather permitting, outdoors in The Olive Grove or in the hotel's garden. Afternoon Tea consists of finger sandwiches, a selection of cakes, a choice of speciality teas, and scones served with jam and the finest Guernsey cream.  A Deluxe, Bellini, Prosecco and Champagne Afternoon Tea menu is also available.  Children can also enjoy their very own Oggie's Afternoon Tea, priced at £17.50 per child (under 12 years old).
pageTitle: The Old Government House Hotel and Spa
